eyebrow: Indonesian tempeh, engineered for global markets

story.title: A traditional Indonesian staple scaled with modern food-safety discipline.
story.body: Azaki presents tempeh as both cultural heritage and export-grade plant protein. The company highlights modern hygienic production, fresh and frozen formats, 80+ factories across Indonesia and distribution to 13 countries.

highlights.title: Global tempeh formats
highlights.body: Fresh, frozen, chips, flour and ready-to-eat formats broaden how tempeh can travel and be consumed.

highlights.title: International certifications
highlights.body: Azaki lists FSSC, HACCP, Halal, SNI, US FDA, GACC and BPOM among its quality credentials.

highlights.title: Plant-based nutrition
highlights.body: The brand emphasizes protein, dietary fiber, preservative-free positioning and traditional fermentation.

highlights.title: Distributed production
highlights.body: Its public story describes expansion to more than 80 factories and cities across Indonesia.
